steps.text: Bring a rope and a shovel.
Dig the loose stone pile west of Kazordoon open with your shovel and go down (minotaurs).
steps.source: Find the loose stone pile west of Kazordoon (Mapper Coords 126.192, 124.249, 7). Use your shovel, and go down the hole.

steps.text: Go down the stairs (minotaurs, minotaur archers).
steps.source: Once down the hole, you will encounter Minotaurs, and Minotaur Archers.

steps.text: Go north-west and up with your rope.
steps.source: Follow the passage to the north-west.

steps.text: In the room with the beds: the box between the beds has the iron hammer.
steps.source: Follow the passage to the north-west until you find a room with beds in it. The quest box is located between a couple of beds.
